chunks: O Prophet, say to your wives: If you desire the life and adornment of this world, then come, I will provide for you handsomely and release you with a graceful release.

key_terms.أُمَتِّعْهُنَّ: I will provide them with maintenance/provision

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (SAWW) offer his wives regarding worldly life versus spiritual devotion?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in the context of the wives of the Prophet (SAWW) choosing between spiritual elevation and worldly comfort, highlights the unique status of the Ummahat al-Mu'minin as distinct from ordinary spouses. Shia scholars emphasize that this 'gracious divorce' (tasreeh jameele) was a temporary arrangement that did not sever their enduring spiritual bond with the Prophet, underscoring their elevated rank in the hierarchy of the faithful. The command to provide maintenance (mut'ah) serves as a practical precedent for financial rights in divorce, while the subsequent verses clarify that their choice was ultimately between the transient world and the eternal hereafter.
